items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer lists Herb Geller in bands featuring the interviewee (Bill Holman); Interviewee confirms participation in these sessions ('That was fun too, just to hear those guys play').

ctx.x: Yeah. I wanted to think of something in Cuba. I remembered having seen those billboards and ads. It‟s the Cuba connection.

Then I‟m showing some jam sessions in July of ‟53: Shorty Rogers, Conrad Gozzo, Maynard Ferguson, Herb Geller, Jack Montrose, Bill Perkins. They‟ve got you listed as bari. Lorraine Geller on piano, John Simmons, bass, Chuck Flores, drums. It was live at the Rendevous Ballroom, Balboa Beach. Any recollection about that?
